name: Châteaumeillant

climate.koppen_name: Temperate, no dry season, warm summer

climate: Seasons this mild ripen Pinot Noir, Sauvignon Blanc, Müller-Thurgau, Pinot Gris and Gewürztraminer fully without cooking off their freshness.
Sauvignon Blanc and Pinot Noir sit in their sweet spot, so the wines can show the style they are known for.

soil.rock: Schist, slate and gneiss break into stony, free-draining soil that holds the day's heat. Schist is rich in magnesium and potassium but poor in organic matter and nitrogen. Limestone makes alkaline soil that drains well yet can hold water for the vines. It is usually planted to grapes valued for their acidity.
soil.top: The topsoil drains well and still stores water for dry spells, so vines grow evenly. Its pH is close to neutral, so vines take up the nutrients they need easily.

land: Gentle slopes. Enough tilt to drain cold air and rain away, which lowers frost risk, yet still easy to farm by machine.

winkler: Only very early grapes ripen well, mostly hybrids and a few vinifera.
